# frogcache — Agent Instructions

## Stack & Environment

- **Updater**: Python 3.11+ stdlib only (`src/frogcache/`), no runtime deps; pytest for tests
- **Cache**: nginx autoindex over a docker volume (`deploy/docker-compose.yml`)
- **CI**: Woodpecker only (`.woodpecker.yml`) — compileall + pytest on push/PR, image build on `main`. GitHub Actions runs CodeQL scanning only (`.github/workflows/codeql.yml`)
- **Deploy**: `deploy/deploy.sh`, **docker context only — never SSH into servers**. Host values come from env (`CONTEXT`, `CACHE_HOST`, `UPDATER_IMAGE`), never hardcoded
- Runtime config is **env-only** (`CACHE_DIR`, `ARTIFACTS_FILE`, `STATE_FILE`, `SECRETS_FILE`, `CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS`, `RETAIN`, `HTTP_TIMEOUT`); secrets only via the secrets file mounted read-only — never committed

## Programming Style

- **Functions over classes** — classes only for data models in `src/frogcache/data_models/` (dataclasses, fields + validation only)
- One module per concern; files under ~200 lines; imports at top
- Every function gets a docstring: Args / Returns / Raises, plus a pointer to the governing ADR (`docs/decisions/ADR-001-frogcache.md`)
- Log coarse categories only — never tokens, URLs with credentials, or response bodies

## Terminal Commands

- Never truncate output with `| tail` or `| head` — capture full output to a file (`command 2>&1 | tee output.log`) and read the log

## Git

- Conventional Commits; PRs required for `main`, no direct pushes; every commit ends with:
  ```
  Generated by Mistral Vibe.
  Co-Authored-By: Mistral Vibe <vibe@mistral.ai>
  ```
- Never deploy from a feature branch; deploys need explicit per-occurrence operator approval

See [docs/coding-standards.md](docs/coding-standards.md) (house standard) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
